mapper.select: SELECT (case when wu.SHORT_NAME IS NULL OR wu.SHORT_NAME = '' OR crew.SHORT_NAME IS NULL OR crew.SHORT_NAME = '' then crew.name else CONCAT(wu.SHORT_NAME, crew.SHORT_NAME) end) as short_name_with_unit ,crew.id ,crew.UNIT_ID ,crew.NAME ,crew.TYPE ,crew.SHORT_NAME FROM OMS_ZF.CREW crew LEFT JOIN OMS_ZF.WORK_UNIT wu on crew.UNIT_ID = wu.ID
